headline: Compare Contacts, from entry to detail
overview: Compare Contacts lets you place two contacts side by side and compare their personality profiles across all available assessments — MBTI, Big Five, DISC, Enneagram, and more. The comparison surface highlights similarities, differences, and potential compatibility or tension points, helping you understand the relational dynamics between any two people in your network.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Side-by-side comparison of personality profiles for any two contacts
Covers all available assessments: MBTI, Big Five, DISC, Enneagram, and more
Highlights key similarities and differences between the two profiles
Compatibility insights to understand potential dynamics between the pair
tips: Use this before mediating a conflict between two people — understanding their personality differences adds important context
Compare yourself with a contact by adding yourself as a contact with your own assessment results
